newsitem.title: USA: NETCOM says adds 83,000 subscribers in Q3.
newsitem.headline: NETCOM says adds 83,000 subscribers in Q3.

text.p: NETCOM On-Line Communication Services Inc said Wednesday it posted its seventh consecutive double-digit growth quarter, adding 83,000 new paid subscribers in its third quarter.

The Internet service provider said in a statement it now has 562,000 clients. The quarter-end result shows a 17 percent growth rate over the previous quarter and compares with 64,000 new paid subscibers in the same period of 1995. The results exclude all complimentary or trial accounts.
